name: CID Home Modification & Assistive Technology Help
description: Help planning and finding funding for home accessibility changes and assistive technology for people with disabilities and older adults
fullDescription: The Center for Independence of Individuals with Disabilities (CID) helps people with disabilities and older adults in San Mateo County plan home accessibility changes, find assistive technology, and look for funding so they can stay safely in their homes.
whatTheyOffer:
- Resource coordination for home modifications (ramps, grab bars, shower changes)
- Help finding funding for home modifications and assistive technology in some situations
- Assistive technology advice and device lending
- Accessible and affordable housing search support
- Bi-weekly list of housing lotteries, waitlists, and openings
howToGetIt:
1. Call CID at 650-645-1780 or email info@cidsanmateo.org
2. Or fill out the contact form on the CID website
3. Meet with CID staff to talk through your needs
4. Get connected to resources, devices, and possible funding sources
address: 2001 Winward Way, Suite 103, San Mateo, CA 94404
keywords: CID, home modifications, wheelchair ramp, grab bars, assistive technology, accessibility, ADA, disabled, elderly, accessible housing, San Mateo
